description: This file defines an immutable class ImmutableLogEntry that implements the LogEntry interface. It provides a structured representation of log entries with fields like correlation ID, timestamp, category, type, level, message, and optional address and thing ID. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, converting to JSON, and standard object methods (equals, hashCode, toString). It also contains an inner builder class for constructing instances.

classes.name: ImmutableLogEntry
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the LogEntry interface representing a log record with various attributes such as ID, timestamp, category, type, level, message, optional address, and optional thing ID.
